episodeTitle.en: The science of product, big bets, and how AI is impacting the future of music | Gustav Söderström
episodeTitle.zh: 产品科学、大赌注以及人工智能如何影响音乐的未来 | 古斯塔夫·索德斯特伦（Gustav Söderström）

guestBioOfficial.en: Gustav Söderström is the Co-President and Chief Product and Technology Officer at Spotify. He is responsible for Spotify’s global product and technology strategy, overseeing the product, design, data, and engineering teams. Prior to Spotify, he founded 13th Lab, a startup that was later acquired by Facebook’s Oculus. He also served as the Director of Product and Business Development for Yahoo Mobile and founded Kenet Works, a company focused on community software for mobile phones, which was acquired by Yahoo in 2006. In today’s episode, we discuss: • How Spotify structures product teams to promote freedom of thought
guestBioOfficial.zh: 古斯塔夫·索德斯特伦（Gustav Söderström）是Spotify的联席总裁兼首席产品与技术官。他负责Spotify的全球产品和技术战略，监管产品、设计、数据和工程团队。在加入Spotify之前，他创立了13th Lab，这家初创公司后来被Facebook的Oculus收购。他还曾担任雅虎移动部门的产品和业务发展总监，并创立了专注于手机社区软件的Kenet Works，该公司于2006年被雅虎收购。在本期节目中，我们将探讨：• Spotify如何构建产品团队以促进思想自由

title.en: The science of product, big bets, and how AI is impacting the future of music | Gustav Söderström
title.zh: 产品科学、大赌注以及人工智能如何影响音乐的未来 | 古斯塔夫·索德斯特伦（Gustav Söderström）

summary.en: Gustav frames the internet's evolution as curation → recommendation → generation, arguing generative AI will force a rethink of products as profound as the shift to recommendation did. He shares what he's learned about placing big bets and what to do when they fail, how Spotify moved away from squads to its current team structure, and how AI is already reshaping Spotify's product and the future of AI-generated music. He also explains why every great product must pull a 'magic trick,' and offers a memorable (and hilarious) analogy about Swedish business culture.
summary.zh: Gustav 把互联网的演进概括为“策展 → 推荐 → 生成”，主张生成式 AI 将迫使产品被重新设想，其深远程度不亚于当年转向推荐。他分享了关于下大赌注、以及赌注失败该如何应对的经验；Spotify 如何放弃 squad 模式、转向如今的团队结构；AI 已如何重塑 Spotify 的产品与 AI 生成音乐的未来。他还解释了为何每一款伟大的产品都必须耍一个“魔术”，并用一个令人难忘（且好笑）的类比谈了瑞典商业文化。
